items.title: Canonical exact-pair diagnosis previously admitted ambiguous benchmark bundles
items.summary: Exact-pair benchmark diagnosis used to admit incomplete selected/base hash bundles and contradictory runtime overrides, which could let non-canonical experiments look like product behavior.
items.exitCriteria: Exact-pair diagnosis fails closed on incomplete selected/base pairs and contradictory runtime override bundles before any retained evidence is generated.

items.title: Explicit Windows runtime bundles previously allowed mixed x86/x64 contamination
items.summary: PROGRAM-0003 entrypoints could accept explicit Windows runtime override bundles that mixed x86 and x64 surfaces when `--prefer-bitness` was omitted, weakening future benchmark and diagnosis truth.
items.exitCriteria: Shared runtime-override validation rejects mixed x86/x64 explicit Windows bundles even when `--prefer-bitness` is omitted.

items.title: Windows pair-129 benchmark proof remains bounded by a Call By Reference seam
items.summary: The accepted cross-OS comparable prefix remains bounded at `129` commits / `128` pairs because both governed Windows surfaces lose truthful comparability at pair `129` around the retained `labview-cli-call-by-reference` seam, and the latest governed repo-local rerun plus direct image probe now show that the published Windows image exposes only x86 `LabVIEWCLI.exe` alongside x64 `LabVIEW.exe` at that boundary.
items.discoveredContext: PROGRAM-0003 comparable-prefix proof and exact-pair Windows diagnosis
items.nextGate: Either retire the pair-129 Windows seam with governed evidence that expands the accepted comparable prefix or close PROGRAM-0003 with the bounded comparable-prefix packet as final benchmark truth.
items.exitCriteria: The comparable benchmark packet either expands beyond pair `128` with truthful Windows evidence or explicitly closes the program on the retained bounded prefix without ambiguity.

items.title: Linux deep benchmark full-window proof remains bounded by pair 135 recursive-load failure
items.summary: The Linux deep `HARNESS-VHS-002` window still fails late at pair `135/138` with retained diagnostic reason `linux-headless-recursive-load`, so the full window is not yet comparable benchmark truth.
items.nextGate: Either complete Linux `138/138` truthfully with the governed deep benchmark lane or keep the full-window blocker explicit while the bounded comparable prefix remains the accepted cross-OS timing scope.
items.exitCriteria: Linux full-window proof either completes truthfully or the repo closes PROGRAM-0003 with the bounded full-window blocker explicitly normalized into the benchmark packet and control plane.

items.title: Synthesized effective runtime override bundles previously bypassed canonical admission control
items.summary: PROGRAM-0003 benchmark entrypoints could synthesize an explicit effective runtime bundle from CLI arguments, environment variables, and entrypoint-local defaults after raw CLI validation had already passed, weakening canonical admission truth.
items.exitCriteria: Benchmark-proof entrypoints validate the effective runtime override bundle after CLI/env/default synthesis, and no hidden explicit Windows runtime executable default is injected when the operator did not request an explicit override.

items.title: Canonical execution-request validation and Docker acquisition UX remain partially implemented
items.summary: The installed extension now exposes a first-class `auto` / `host-only` / `docker-only` execution-mode setting, rejects silent provider fallback, uses selected Windows host-runtime facts such as `LabVIEW.ini`, the derived governed VI Server TCP port, and observed host activity to keep `auto` host-first on clean surfaces and Docker-required on contaminated ones, and now validates explicit Windows container-capability facts such as Docker CLI availability, daemon reachability, active container mode, and governed image presence before the Windows provider is selected or rejected. Canonical effective execution-request validation remains only partially implemented because visible Windows image-pull progress and fuller front-facing provider and acquisition transparency remain open.
items.discoveredContext: Post-release execution-flexibility and contamination-safe runtime UX planning
items.nextGate: Finish canonical effective execution-request validation through visible image-pull progress and fuller front-facing provider/acquisition transparency after the landed Windows host-fact and Docker-capability selector slices.
items.exitCriteria: The installed extension exposes `auto`, `host-only`, and `docker-only`; validates one canonical effective execution request before host launch or Docker acquisition; fails closed with mode-aware guidance when the selected provider cannot run truthfully; treats Windows Docker CLI availability, daemon reachability, container-mode capability, and governed image presence as explicit prerequisites; shows chosen provider, rejected providers, acquisition state, and next action in front-facing UX; and surfaces visible Docker acquisition progress when the governed image must be pulled.
